newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - July 30.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on July 30:
WASHINGTON - The cost of most workers' pay and benefits rose only moderately over the last year, according to a Labor Department report.
NEW YORK - Wall Street is already counting the money it will make off the pro-savings provisions in the budget and tax-cut deal between President Clinton and congressional leaders.
WASHINGTON - Two recent CSX Corp. train wrecks have given the Transportation Department ammunition to press for new railroad safety improvements.

WASHINGTON - Access Beyond Inc. a computer communications gear maker, said it will merge with Hayes Microcomputer Products Inc., a Georgia company whose name has become synonomous with computer modems.
